Wind charges are disabled by default because the server treats them like explosions however no blocks are actually destroyed.
Requires a restart to change.
The options below require a server restart to be applied due to performance issues.
It'll throw the blocks in the air! This feature isn't really related to Kingdoms, but it's kept here for historical purposes. It still works.
When a siege cannon is able to destroy kingdom items (turrets & structures) should the kingdom item drop or not. If not, the item will be permanently lost.
Requires a restart to apply. When set to false, blocks will simply not disappear at all.
The delay before starting the regeneration in ticks.
The interval between each block regeneration in ticks.
Auto regenerate the blocks slowly. This option has its own limitations. Containers such as chests will not be removed. Kingdom items (turrets and structures) will not be removed.
Drop kingdom items destroyed by explosions instead of discarding them.
